description: Generate a collection of edges representing a statistical distribution of fractures within user-specified domain from a provided Discrete Fracture Network (DFN). Please refer to DFN overview for the DFN logic and commands.

keywords.name: dfn
keywords.description: Create edges from the DFN with name s .

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: Assign group name s1 in slot s2 (if supplied) to the edges representing fractures. If slot keyword is omitted, slot Default is used.

notes: FLAC2D only: the FLAC3D sketch rejects it.
Set the domain first with sketch fracture domain; it is deleted after each create.
The manual also lists keep-domain and minimum-length; the 9.8 build reports them as unused parameters.
